title: SEC0-R2: all 14 fixes verified correct
description:
Verified all 14 round-1 fixes as correct.

c3z.2 (sieve_admin.rs): VERIFIED. start_sieve_admin_server correctly implements the 3-way fail-closed logic: loopback → spawn; non-loopback + no allow_non_loopback → Err; non-loopback + allow_non_loopback + no bearer_token → Err; non-loopback + allow_non_loopback + bearer_token → spawn. Tests cover all four arms.

c3z.4 (session.rs SieveCache): VERIFIED. SieveCache = Arc<Mutex<HashMap<String, Option<Arc<CompiledScript>>>>> with None as compile-failed sentinel. sieve_for_user correctly returns Err fast on None sentinel. Admin API (sieve_admin.rs) calls sieve_cache.lock().await.remove(&username) on PUT, DELETE, and activate — clearing the sentinel. Test sieve_for_user_compile_error_returns_err checks err.contains('compile') || err.contains('Sieve').

c3z.5 (suck_pull.rs line 149): VERIFIED. Line 149: msgids.push(trimmed.to_ascii_lowercase()); normalizes incoming Message-IDs from NEWNEWS response to ASCII lowercase before storing.

c3z.6 (reader node_id): VERIFIED. reader/src/store/server_stores.rs implements load_node_id() with 3-level priority: (1) operator.node_id hex from config, (2) node_id.bin in data dir, (3) generate+persist+warn. reader/src/config.rs has DataConfig.dir field with default_data_dir()='.' and validates operator.node_id hex string. Matches transit logic.

c3z.8 (admin stats DB pool): VERIFIED. transit/src/admin.rs build_stats_json takes both transit_pool and core_pool; msgid_map query SELECT COUNT(*) FROM msgid_map uses core_pool. transit/src/main.rs passes Arc::clone(&core_pool_admin) as second arg to start_admin_server. Fix is complete.

c3z.10 (GC regression test): VERIFIED. gc_run_once_uses_date_ms_to_derive_age_days test creates old_candidate (60 days) and new_candidate (5 days) against a max_age_days=30 policy. Asserts unpinned==1. Comment documents regression oracle. Test would fail if age_days were always 0.

c3z.11 (epoch test validate_headers.rs): VERIFIED. check_date_at(headers, wall_secs) is split out as a pub(crate)-visible fn. Tests date_at_wall_time_accepted (wall_secs=0, article=epoch, delta=0 -> OK) and date_at_epoch_error_branch_via_check_date_at (wall_secs=0, article=year2000, delta>>86400 -> 441). Both tests operate without SystemTime::now().

c3z.13 (key length tests): VERIFIED. server_stores.rs tests signing_key_file_too_short_is_rejected (31 bytes → err contains '32 bytes'), signing_key_file_too_long_is_rejected (33 bytes → err contains '32 bytes'), signing_key_file_exact_32_bytes_is_accepted (32 bytes → Ok).

c3z.16 (sieve test assertion): VERIFIED. sieve_for_user_compile_error_returns_err checks: err.contains('compile') || err.contains('Sieve'). The actual error string is 'Sieve compile error for {username}' which satisfies both conditions.

c3z.18 (msgid pipeline test): VERIFIED. case_insensitive_msgid_duplicate_detected test uses run_pipeline to insert <ABC@EXAMPLE.COM>, then check_ingest for both <ABC@EXAMPLE.COM> (expects Duplicate) and <abc@example.com> (expects Duplicate). Tests both casings.

c3z.21 (HLC struct access): VERIFIED as not-a-bug. HlcTimestamp has pub node_id: [u8; 8]. HlcClock has private node_id field. Tests in the same file as HlcClock can access private struct fields directly. The struct is in core/src/hlc.rs; no external access is needed. Correctly closed.

c3z.1 (node_id warn transit/main.rs): VERIFIED. main.rs lines 296-303 emit warn! when generating new node_id.bin. Message includes path and explains that HLC node identity has changed, which is appropriate for backup restore / container re-image context.

c3z.3 (config error message transit/config.rs): VERIFIED. check_admin_config returns ConfigError::Validation with messages that include 'admin.bearer_token = \"<your-token>\"' and 'admin.allow_non_loopback = true' and 'or change admin.addr to a loopback address (127.0.0.1 or ::1)'. Full migration instructions present.

c3z.23 (QP oracle mime_parser.rs): VERIFIED. test_qp_decoding_rfc2045_example accesses decoded bytes via parsed.blocks[0].1 (index-based), not CID lookup. Comment explicitly states 'CID lookup would be self-referential' and explains the oracle is RFC 2045 §6.7. Same pattern for base64 test (RFC 4648 §10). Both tests use byte-exact comparison against independent RFC-specified vectors.

No defects found in any of the 14 fixes. All are correct, complete, and have no new bugs introduced.
